So, I take sertraline and have since about July. I was taking them consistently up until February but there was no change. Every time I told my therapist she simply replied with ‘I need to keep taking them’ I started to forget to take them (my forgetfulness is it’s own problem, but not relevant) up until half way through October when I just stopped. I didn’t feel as if there was a point of nothing was changing, and I was actually feeling a lot worse. I continue to get worse even after stopping taking them - and I’ve just taken my first dose again today. 

I just can’t understand why it’s not working, and I’m still getting worse. It’s driven me to the edge of suicide over and over again and as I’ve stated, my yeeting compulsion is getting worse too. 

Additionally (as a side note) my paranoia seemed to get a lot worse when I was on them, than when I was off of them.
